No. G450] PORT MORESBY, TUESDAY, 15th OCTOBER [2013

THE NATIONAL ICT ACT 2009

NOTICE OF MAKING INSTRUMENTS UNDER THE NATIONAL ICT ACT 2009

I, Kila Gulo-Vui, Acting Chief Executive Officer of the National Information and Communications
Technology Authority (also referred to as NICTA), by virtue of the powers conferred by Section 135 of the
National ICT Act 2009 and all other powers me enabling, hereby give notice to the following determination
made by NICTA pursuant to the National ICT Act 2009.

Service-specific Pricing Principles (Submarine Cable Access Services) Determination No 1/2013 for the following
declared services:

(a) international submarine cable transmission capacity service; and
(b) international submarine cable gateway access service.
This Determination was made by NICTA on 17th September, 2013 takes effect from the date published herein.

Dated this 18th day of October, 2013.

K. GULO-VUI,
Acting Chief Executive Officer.

Printed and Published by K. Kaiah, Government Printer,
Port Moresby —465.
